_comment: Golden set for app.services.paper_resolver.resolve_papers, authored against the live corpus of project fa2ab869-6b13-4b31-be5e-ff0c22652922 (100 papers). Every title/author/year below was queried from that project's real rows -- none invented. expect_titles is a list of title substrings a correct resolution must produce (order-insensitive); an empty list asserts resolve_papers must return nothing (fall through to the LLM targeter). No runner consumes this file yet -- see app/services/paper_resolver.py (resolve_papers, and its _MIN_SPAN_WORDS docstring) for the intended consumer; run_eval.py's --multi mode measures the multi-paper CUT given an already-resolved paper set, not resolution, and does not read this file. It exists for a future resolver harness.
